title: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.9.0 Suite Released!
message: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.9.0 — Major Update
changelog: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.9.0 — Major Update
Shape Tools Suite Redesign: Compact, collapsible, and fully responsive UI for docked & pop-out panels.
1-Click Quick Shapes: Instantly create Square, Rounded Rectangle, Circle, Star, Triangle, and Line shape layers with auto Fill & Stroke.
- New Presets dropdown with 1-click built-in gradients and custom saved gradient presets.
- Live Start & End color swatches, Hex code inputs, Eyedropper pickers, Linear/Radial toggle, Angle, and Spread controls.
- Independent Solid Fill, Gradient Fill, Solid Stroke, and Gradient Stroke controls with active state highlights.
Compact Trim Paths, Taper & Dashes: Side-by-side Taper and Dashes cards with streamlined Trim Paths, Round Cap, and Round Join controls.
- Added single-select X, Y, and Z rotation axis options for Auto-Rotate.
- Fixed 3D Sphere top/bottom layer rotation when using many icons.
